statement: Typed quotient-and-incidence firewall. After normalizing Laurent associates and listing the D irreducible factor occurrences H_nu of B, the polynomial family Qcal(y)=product_nu((1-y_nu)+y_nu H_nu) legally specializes at Boolean occurrence vectors to every normalized divisor quotient Q_j^norm. It has total degree D and can realize 2^D specializations, so coordinatewise multilinearity gives no bounded-complexity M01 theorem; a lambda-indexed interpolation can likewise require degree K-1. In the actual Euclidean block there are S common source points, at most qU targets, and at most KU targets in the selected reciprocal hub. Hence source-to-all-target, selected-target-pair, and selected-to-all-target pair capacities have exponents 7/3, 25/9, and 53/18 respectively, all below 3, while only the full target-pair domain reaches 28/9. The formal KS^2Uq capacity 11/3 is not a point-pair domain. Any repaired M10 route must propagate chart control to all qU targets and prove actual distance-fibre exponent below 1/9-epsilon; 26/9 is inadmissible.

prove an M01 factor-labelled consequence beyond Boolean subset recovery and the exact divisor-width scalar map
